verdict.rationale: Stable documents OCR output on scanned mail: the MailItem object's scanDetails includes ocrResultUrls and a summary, alongside high-res scans. Its API also supports searching MailItems, and keyword-based routing implies the text inside mail is read. However, no evidence shows that search can filter by sender, full-text content, or date, so the searchable-archive half of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: documented search filters for sender/content/date, dashboard full-text search of OCR'd content, independent or hands-on corroboration.
